text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Known-answer gate: a one-signed offset added to the observed power on 40 ordinary days per panel row (8 per substation), forecasts with 3.5-hour-old power from origins every 6 hours. Dot: share removed against A0. Line: 95% interval from resampling the 40 cases. Green rule: the pre-registered pass mark of 50%.'
text.tspan: Known-answer gate: a one-signed offset added to the observed power on 40 ordinary days per panel row (8
per substation), forecasts with 3.5-hour-old power from origins every 6 hours. Dot: share removed against
A0. Line: 95% interval from resampling the 40 cases. Green rule: the pre-registered pass mark of 50%.
